STARTING LINEUPSReal Madrid starting XI: Lunin; Trent, Rüdiger, Huijsen, Carreras; Tchouaméni, Camavinga, Güler, Angel; Brahim and Mbappé.Mallorca starting XI (TBC): Leo Román; Maffeo, David López, Valjent, Mojica; Mascarell, Samu Costa, Carder; Mateo Joseph, Pablo Torre and Muriqi.HOW TO WATCH, STREAM LA LIGADate: 04/04/2026Time: 16:15 CET, 10:15am EST.Venue: Son Moix, Mallorca, Spain.Available TV: DAZN La Liga (Spain), ESPN Deportes (USA).Available Streaming: ESPN+ (USA)Managing Madrid has affiliate partnerships.
